minimumSetRule: Walk eventOrder; select an event when it covers at least one still-uncovered required decision.

dimensions.insightCoverage: percentage of required decision IDs covered

nonClaims: Scores are not measured insight, privacy, identifiability, benefit, legal risk, or behavior.
Declared minimum set does not prove necessity, proportionality, minimization, anonymity, or compliance.
Consent, legal basis, retention, deletion, aggregation, and rights behavior require contextual and production verification.
